rows.title: Red Cliff
rows.comment: Woo's Hong Kong films are masterful (and quite literal) examples of the body deconstructing architecture
rows.verdict_le10: Woo's Hong Kong films are masterful (and quite literal) examples of the body deconstructing architecture
rows.dek_lead: Woo's Hong Kong films are masterful (and quite literal) examples of the body deconstructing architecture, but instead of the usual balustrades to slide on or balconies to careen over, Red Cliff offers a much larger landscape to contend

rows.title: How John Woo Shot Spectacular Period Epic ‘Red Cliff’
rows.dek_lead: Lust, Caution star Tony Leung, Takeshi Kaneshiro (House of Flying Daggers) and the pan-Asian cast are superb, their characters identifiable and accessible. Red Cliff is exhilarating, eye-popping, and fun.

rows.title: Red Cliff Review
rows.comment: the best thing John Woo has made in years.
rows.verdict_le10: the best thing John Woo has made in years.
rows.dek_lead: Camp, over-the-top and entirely unbelievable: in short, the best thing John Woo has made in years.
